steps.code:
# Parse the note content to extract song titles and artists
content = note_content['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the first line which is the header
song_lines = lines[1:]
songs = []
for line in song_lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    # Split on " by " to get title and artists
    if ' by ' in line:
        title_part, artists_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
        songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists})
    else:
        # If no " by ", treat whole line as title
        songs.append({'title': line, 'artists': []})
print(songs)
